title: API protocols: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SSE
status: TEMPLATE SLICE. This domain is the reference format for the other 36.
why_this_domain_first: It exercises every layer of the design: capture, schema recovery, hypothesis, test, oracle, defense. If the format works here it works everywhere.

atom_notes.A01: schema and query strings reach an interpreter, the GraphQL and SQL injection family
atom_notes.A02: object level and function level authorization, the BOLA and BFLA family
atom_notes.A03: token or identity confusion across API versions, gateways and microservices
atom_notes.A05: type and shape confusion, mass assignment, duplicate keys, null coercion
atom_notes.A06: path and route confusion, versioning, shadow routes, gateway vs service routing
atom_notes.A10: business logic in stateful endpoints, sequence and quota abuse
atom_notes.A12: race conditions in idempotent looking endpoints
atom_notes.A16: the API is an LLM or agent endpoint, tool calls and prompt injection

required_cells.why: you cannot test an API you have not enumerated
route and parameter discovery at scale is the highest yield API step
schema to hypothesis: what is likely broken given this shape
automated probing with a real oracle, not a scanner's guess
BOLA and BFLA exploitation needs two identities and object ids
proof with a negative control, the difference between a finding and a guess
API findings need impact framing or they get closed as informational
retest after fix, nobody covers this
continuous schema diff, new endpoints appear weekly

entries.name: kiterunner
entries.role: API route brute force with real-world route wordlists
preconditions: API routes are guessable from naming conventions
no global 404 normalisation
entries.note: The route wordlists matter more than the tool. Assetnote's kite files encode real API shapes.
entries.mirror_note: no mirror row covers this entry

entries.name: ffuf
entries.role: Generic fuzzer, the fallback when a protocol specific tool does not exist
preconditions: a fuzz position exists in the request
entries.note: Set -rate. An agent that ignores rate is a denial of service, not a tester.
entries.mirror_note: no mirror row covers this entry

entries.name: arjun

entries.name: clairvoyance
entries.role: Recover a GraphQL schema when introspection is disabled
preconditions: introspection disabled but field suggestions enabled
or error messages leak field names
detected_by: introspection query signature and field suggestion probing
entries.note: This is the canonical example of a tool that exists because a defence (introspection off) was assumed sufficient and was not.

entries.name: InQL
entries.role: Introspection to ready-made queries, one per field, plus IDE integration

entries.name: graphw00f
entries.role: GraphQL engine fingerprint, decides which defence bypass class applies
preconditions: an exposed graphql endpoint
entries.note: Engine matters because batching, alias limits and introspection quirks differ per engine. Fingerprint before you payload.

entries.name: mitmproxy2swagger
entries.role: Turn captured traffic into an OpenAPI spec, the reverse of codegen
preconditions: you captured real traffic from a real client
entries.note: The single highest leverage API step. A spec turns guessing into property testing.

entries.name: grpcurl
entries.role: gRPC reflection, describe and call, the whole gRPC surface
preconditions: server reflection enabled, common in internal services exposed by mistake
entries.note: Reflection on is equivalent to a free full schema. Nobody checks it.

tree.q: Do you have a schema or a capture for this API?
tree.why: Everything downstream depends on this. Guessing without a schema is the least efficient mode and the most common mistake.

branches.a: Yes, OpenAPI or GraphQL schema in hand

next.q: Is the schema generated by the vendor or recovered by you?
Does the live API match the spec on undocumented fields?
next.action: diff spec against live responses, undocumented fields are the finding surface

next.q: Are there endpoints in the client that traffic never touched?
next.action: bundle and mobile artifact diff against the captured endpoint set

branches.a: No schema, only a live endpoint

branches.action: fingerprint engine, try introspection, if off recover fields by suggestion abuse
attempt reflection, then describe, then call with empty message to map fields
capture one authenticated session, convert to spec, then fuzz from the spec
record frames, look for client side trust and message type confusion

mirror.detect: object id enumeration pattern per session
mirror.control: object level authorisation check on every read, not on the list endpoint
function level authorisation, deny by default

mirror.detect: introspection query signature and field suggestion probing
mirror.control: disable suggestions too, not just introspection
mirror.rule: query depth and suggestion error rate

mirror.control: cost analysis per operation, not per request
explicit allowlist binding, never object hydration from body

mirror.detect: live response shape differs from spec
same token accepted by services with different audiences

gaps.gap: No tool recovers a GraphQL schema when both introspection and suggestions are off
gaps.build_candidate: differential error oracle that recovers field names from validation messages, then type names from union errors

gaps.gap: No tool diffs a client bundle's endpoint set against captured traffic automatically
gaps.build_candidate: join rea analyze_web_bundle routes with rea inspect_web_network_capture urls, emit the set difference

gaps.gap: No tool tests object level authorisation across N users automatically
gaps.build_candidate: create M identities, replay every captured object request as each identity, flag any 200 that should be 403
frame schema inference from capture plus type confusion mutations

gaps.gap: No tool verifies a fix without a full rescan
gaps.build_candidate: store the exact request that proved the finding, replay it as the retest, diff the oracle

gaps.gap: L10 impact framing and L11 retest cells are empty in this domain
gaps.build_candidate: impact template per API class plus a retest harness
